examTips: Colour blanks mein **red bicycle**, **blue seat** aur **black tyres and pedals** yaad rakho. Tyres aur pedals dono likhna.
Textbook ke correct/incorrect answers isi order mein hain: **incorrect, correct, incorrect, incorrect, correct**. Bicycle blue nahi; hamesha fast nahi; water nahi, air chahiye.
Bicycle picture ke boxes mein help box se **sahi spelling** likho. **Wheel** aur **pedal** ke labels aapas mein mat badlo.
Poem ke answers mein **The child** likh sakte ho. Magic bicycle wale answer mein apni pasand ki jagah aur wahan kya karoge, yeh **do chhoti sentences** mein batao.
content.funFact: Poem ke **ride–aside** aur **black–track** ko bolkar dekho. Inke ending sounds milte hain! Aise words ko **rhyming words** kehte hain.

keyPoints.heading: Bicycle aur bell
points: Bachche ke paas **red bicycle** hai. Woh pedal chalakar ride karta hai.
Bell **“Trin… trin… trin…”** bajti hai. Iski awaaz friends ko side mein hatne ko kehti hai.
Yaad rakhne ke liye bolo: **“Trin-trin bell bajaye, friends ko side hataye!”** Isse bell ka sound aur uska kaam yaad rahega.

keyPoints.heading: Colours aur speed
points: **Seat blue** hai. **Tyres aur pedals black** hain.
Bicycle kabhi **fast**, kabhi **slow** chalti hai. Lekin hamesha **on track**, yani apne raaste par rehti hai.
Mann mein picture banao: **red bicycle**, **blue seat**, **black tyres aur pedals**. Har part ko uske colour se jodo.

keyPoints.heading: Air, helmet aur reading words
points: Poem mein bachcha kehta hai ki bicycle ko chalte rehne ke liye kuch **air** chahiye. Woh apna chhota **helmet** pehenkar khushi se har jagah jaata hai.
Chhoti story yaad rakho: tyres mein **air**, sir par **helmet**, phir happy ride! Isse air aur helmet waale answers yaad rahenge.
Sight words ko pehchano aur padho: **I, and, is, in, my**.
New words padho: **pedal, aside, sometimes**, track, helmet, everywhere.

keyPoints.heading: Speaking aur sounds
points: Apni dekhi hui **bicycle** ke baare mein bolo: kahan dekhi, kya colour tha aur kaun chalata hai. **Tricycle** aur **wheelchair** dekhne ka experience bhi batao.
**Wheels** movement mein madad karte hain. Kuch buzurg, chot lage log aur disabilities waale log wheelchair use karte hain.
**School bell**, **bicycle bell** aur **temple bell** ki awaazein sunkar pehchano.
Chhote groups mein bolo: **an ant, an axe, an apple**; **a rat, a cat, a mat**; **a pan, a man, a cap**. Pehle group ke teeno words a se shuru hote hain aur unke pehle an hai. Pan ka a sound suno.

keyPoints.heading: Labels, imagination aur written answers
points: Bicycle ke parts ke labels hain: **seat, pedal, wheel**, bell, handle, carrier, brake. Saat fingers par ek-ek naam gino; koi label chhootega nahi.
Apni **magic bicycle** banao. Socho: kahan jaaoge, kya karoge aur kya dekhoge? Yeh tumhari imagination ka answer hai.
Fill in the blanks ke answers order mein: **red**; **bell**; **tyres and pedals**.
Correct ya incorrect ka order: **incorrect, correct, incorrect, incorrect, correct**. Bicycle red hai, bell trin bolti hai, speed badalti hai, water nahi air chahiye, aur bachcha helmet pehenta hai.

keyTerms.meaning: Bicycle ka woh **part** jise pair se chalate hain; pedal karna yani pair se use chalana.
**Side mein**; bell sunkar friends side mein hat jaate hain.
**Kabhi-kabhi**; bicycle kabhi fast, kabhi slow chalti hai.
**Raasta**; on track yani apne raaste par.
Sir ko surakshit rakhne ke liye pehni jaane waali **mazboot topi**.
**Har jagah**; bachcha khushi se har jagah jaata hai.
Wheels ke baahar lage **rubber ke ghere**; poem mein ye black hain.
